back: Data in a file is kept after the program ends or the power is off; it can be reused, shared and backed up.
OPENFILE "name.txt" FOR READ  or  OPENFILE "name.txt" FOR WRITE
Creates a new file: any existing data in a file of that name is lost.
READFILE "name.txt", Variable reads the next line into the variable.
WRITEFILE "name.txt", Value adds the value as the next line.
CLOSEFILE "name.txt" when the program has finished with it.
Open before the loop, read or write inside it, close after it.
0478 pseudocode has no EOF function: the number of lines is given or a terminator line (e.g. "END") is used.
To read a file you have just written, close it and reopen it FOR READ.
